description: Search Product Hunt's public products, launches, or users by query. Reads Apollo SSR search data first, follows numbered result pages serially, and falls back to visible search DOM when page data drifts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results, strict positive integer from 1 to 100

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Search result type: product, launch, or user

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Standard sort: default, latest, or popular; unsupported Product Hunt values are reported in ignoredParams

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Standard time range: all, day, week, month, or year; Product Hunt search has no verified time filter and reports non-all values in ignoredParams
